name: Negative-funding capitulation long — short-crowd squeeze fuel (funding + RSI + basis, 4h)
rationale: MECHANISM: deeply negative funding_rate means SHORTS are crowded and PAYING longs to hold — historically a capitulation/bottom tell (Mar-2020, Nov-2022 FTX ~$15.5k). The other side is panicked/forced shorts and hedgers; a contrarian SPOT long (direction +1) is paid twice — funding carry (a long receives when funding is negative, wired via funding_feature) PLUS the short-squeeze recovery when shorts must cover. We require RSI oversold (a genuine washout, not a slow bleed) AND perp_spot_basis negative (perp trading below spot = active short pressure) to confirm the one-sided short crowd. Persists because negative funding is rare and painful, so systematic capital under-allocates. Hold ~0.5-2d. DISCONFIRMER 1: kill if negative-funding events are too rare to clear effective-N (may fire <10-20 times). DISCONFIRMER 2: kill if the bounce is indistinguishable from a plain oversold-RSI long without the funding + basis conditions. DISCONFIRMER 3: kill if it catches knives during structural bear capitulation (negative funding can persist for weeks per 46-day stretches) rather than marking the turn.
catalyst: deeply negative funding + oversold RSI + perp discount to spot — an over-short crowd a spot long squeezes.
